entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi, Diana. I'm calling about my new VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I need to return it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the VeloBand? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
It's a fault. The pulse reading is all over the place, it's completely inaccurate. To be honest, the sensor is just garbage. I'm really disappointed.

I'm very sorry to hear that. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Our technical support team is excellent with these kinds of issues. Would you be open to me transferring you to them to see if we can get it working for you?

Oh, please no. I'm just so let down. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for a long time, and I really don't have time to sit on another call. I just want money back. I really needed this to work, you know?
I completely understand your position, and I truly appreciate your loyalty. I don't want to waste any more of your time. Let me just pull up your order details.
Okay. I just... I want a refund. I feel bad asking, but it doesn't work.

Of course. I see here that the item was delivered 21 days ago. Let me just double-check our policy for you... Yes, it looks like you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that return for a full refund for you right now.
Oh, really? That's such a relief. I was so worried. Thank you.

It's my pleasure. And I see here you're a VIP member. To apologize for the faulty device and the inconvenience this has caused, I'm going to email you a pre-paid shipping label immediately, and I've also added a $25 credit to your account for future use.
Wow, that's very kind of you. Thank you so much, Diana. You've been a great help.

You are very welcome. The email with that label and confirmation is on its way now. Just send the item back in its original box, and your refund will be issued as soon as we receive it. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
You too. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
